_comment_packId: CRITICAL: This ID is used by the engine. 'core' and any ID containing the word 'base' load automatically at the start of the game.
_comment_CHARACTERS: This dictionary defines the art, names, and visual effects for anyone speaking in this deck. The keys (like 'char_1') are what you reference in the cards below.

char_1._comment_imageFx: Optional CSS injected directly into the card to give the character portrait a unique glow or shadow.
char_1.name: Kargoth the Ironclad
char_1.flavor: A towering wall of muscle and rust. He speaks in grunts and violence.

char_2.name: Snivel the Goblin
char_2.flavor: A wretched creature from the deep warrens.

char_3.name: Uruk Warlord
char_3.flavor: A hulking brute demanding tribute or blood.

char_4.name: Greenfang Bruiser
char_4.flavor: Commander of the green tide. Thinks with his fists.

_comment_DECK_JSON: This array holds all the actual event cards for this pack.

DECK_JSON._comment_charId: Ties this card to Kargoth above. The engine will pull his name and art automatically.
DECK_JSON._comment_dialogues: Optional array. Creates the buttons the player can tap to ask questions before swiping.

dialogues.text: Buried under the old latrine.
Brown dust on them makes humies sick. <Very good/Excellent>.

DECK_JSON._comment_rightChoice: The swipe actions. 'effects' apply to the 4 main stats.
DECK_JSON._comment_prompt: The main text. Words inside < > separated by a slash are randomized every time the card is drawn! Text inside [[ ]] will be clickable lore.
DECK_JSON.prompt: Found a <stash/pile> of rusted stab-sticks. Give to my brutes, or melt for shiny?

dialogues.text: They eat rats. Or they eat each other. Not Kargoth’s <problem/worry>.
Let them try. Kargoth will squash them like bugs.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My unit need more <meat/gristle>. Make the little green ones give us their food.

dialogues.text: No eye-squishing. Groin-kicking is very <good/encouraged>.
Then you is Boss. But Kargoth never lose.

DECK_JSON.prompt: You fight me in the pit! Show who is <strongest/boss>. Or you scared?

dialogues.text: It looked like a shiny beetle. Was <crunchy/tasty>.
Kargoth’s stomach digest iron. Key might be gone soon.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Kargoth eat the door-key. Very safe now. We wait, or you chop me open?
Armor <broke/shattered>. Boyz laughing at me. Give gold to fix, or Kargoth fight naked.

dialogues.text: Sickly green! It makes my teeth hum!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We founds a shiny rock, but it makes our handsies <burn/sting> real bad!

dialogues.text: We used the mushrooms from the spider-holes! They tastes like <colors/rainbows>!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We cooks a new mush-stew! It glowings in the dark, yes it does!

dialogues.text: We thought they was very hard <cheeses/candies>!

DECK_JSON.prompt: The shiny rocks in the vault… we ate some. Now our tummies is <screaming/hurting>!

dialogues.text: Just a sign that says ‘Certain Doom.’ Probably a humie <trick/trap>!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Uh oh… we finds a door with a giant head-bone on it! Should Snivel knock?

dialogues.text: Three extra moldy crusts, or they stop eating the <plague-rats/bugs>!

DECK_JSON.prompt: The rat-catchers say they makes a ‘guild’! They screaming for more fuzz-mold!

dialogues.text: It has shiny rocks on the side! Very good for <scraping/digging>.
We washed it in the slime-river! Good as new!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We finds a yellow shiny cup! It makes scooping the poop-pits very <fancy/royal>!
A humie drops a ‘Cookbook’! Now the cooks is crying and won’t feed us the raw <meat/flesh>!

dialogues.text: Lavender and shiny judgment!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We finds a ‘Bar of Soap’ in a humie kit! The boys want to know if it’s an edible holy relic.

nextCard.cardText: The ‘Hero’ was full of strong grog! The pit monsters is now drunk and singing sea shanties!

DECK_JSON.prompt: A dirty ‘Hero’ is at the big door! He smells like old grog. Makes him a <scout/guard>?

dialogues.text: Enough to drown our Vanguard in blood. We should use the <traps/walls>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The men of the West are marching on our <upper gates/walls>.

dialogues.text: Then we take it out of your <hide/gold>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My Uruks demand a larger share of the plunder to stay in line. <Pay up/Coin now>.

dialogues.text: I will wear his skull as a <codpiece/goblet>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I challenge the Greenfang Bruiser to a duel for supremacy of the [[Vanguard]].

dialogues.text: He muttered something about a ‘Meat-Grinder <3000/Alpha>’.

DECK_JSON.prompt: We captured a dwarven engineer. I want to torture him. The goblins want him to build traps.

dialogues.text: It was heavily perfumed and asked politely. <Disgusting/Weak>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The dwarven king sent a formal scroll demanding we stop chanting at midnight. I intend to eat the messenger.

nextCard.cardText: Pathetic. The messenger was wearing concealed spiked armor. I am now in the infirmary.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My scouts captured an elven bard. He won’t stop playing the <lute/flute>. It is demoralizing.
I demand better siege engines. We cannot conquer the surface with sharpened <logs/sticks>.
My lieutenant challenged me for command. I can crush him, but he is a skilled fighter.

dialogues.text: He wears two swords on his back, which seems <excessive/try-hard>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I found a surface Knight who claims he’s ‘neutral.’ He wants a permit to hunt the slime in the basement.
Da boyz is hungry! Rat meat is garbage! We wants real meat, with lots of <screaming/flavor>!

dialogues.text: Lots! They make funny squeaks when Greenfang throw rocks at them.
Not as sturdy as Greenfang’s <head/fist>!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Humies put up wood walls outside! Greenfang wants to smash it into toothpicks!

dialogues.text: But it’s SHINY! Imagine the glare in their eyes!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Dis iron pinching my gut. Make da smithy give Greenfang pure gold armor! Shiny make boyz fight harder!

dialogues.text: Da Swarm usually eats ‘em before they get <cold/stiff>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Da boyz got no one to hit! Can we makes a fight pit? Winner drinks da loser’s <grog/blood>!

dialogues.text: Leftover Rat-Stew! Extra <slippery/slimy>!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Greenfang gonna grease da front door ramp! Humies gonna slip and go SPLAT!

dialogues.text: It had a very solid <defensive stance/shield>.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Greenfang headbutt a rock-spike. The rock won. Da boyz is laughing! Lemme break their heads!
We loot a humie wagon. Gots lots of fancy silk hats! Da boyz wanna wear ‘em when we chop heads!
The <dungeon/stronghold> is stable, but the lower depths are <calling/whispering>. Expand?
